$comment: Operator-curated list of marketplace modules baked into THIS cobblr-core image. Foundational + stock modules are NOT listed here — they live in modules/ and ship with the repo. Each entry has kind: "module" (in-process JS, marketplace v0.2) or kind: "sandboxed" (wasm-isolated, marketplace v0.3). The image-build pipeline (scripts/install-registry-modules.mjs) fetches each entry's tarball, verifies sha256 + ed25519 signature, extracts to /app/modules/<name>/ or /app/sandboxed-modules/<name>/ respectively. Edit + rebuild the image to ship a new module or version. See docs/modules/marketplace.md.

modules.name: bricklink-connector
modules.$comment: Vendored mode = read from modules/<name>/ in this repo, skip the registry fetch. Used during the transition while bricklink-connector's external repo is being set up. Flip to source: "registry" once v0.1.0 has a signed tarball published in the registry.

modules.name: hello-wasm
modules.$comment: v0.3 PoC sample. The sandbox loader picks up sandboxed-modules/<name>/ at api boot regardless of this list — the cobblr-modules entry is here to surface it in installed-modules.manifest.json (the super-admin audit view) + lock the version pin for future registry-sourced installs.
